entries.what: Model deepseek-chat is retired. The announcement was written before the date, and no later page confirms it took effect.

source.quote: deepseek-chat & deepseek-reasoner will be fully retired and inaccessible after Jul 24th, 2026, 15:59 (UTC Time).

requires: Both support thinking and non-thinking modes, so check which mode the old model name stood for.

entries.what: Model deepseek-reasoner is retired. The announcement was written before the date, and no later page confirms it took effect.

source.quote: deepseek-chat & deepseek-reasoner will be fully retired and inaccessible after Jul 24th, 2026, 15:59 (UTC Time).

entries.replacement: deepseek-v4-flash, or deepseek-v4-pro, in thinking mode.
requires: Thinking is now a mode of the model rather than a model of its own: see the Thinking Mode guide.
